stages.action: Find the existing scoped session and open conversation; verify Nathan and Dot can communicate with it.
stages.failure: Park if attachment or conversation access is absent; do not duplicate the writer.

stages.action: Read actual executor, branch, HEAD, isolated worktree, owned paths, current writer inventory and prior checkpoint.
stages.failure: Park on wrong host, overlapping writer, stale ownership or uncertain prior effects.

stages.action: Bind request identity, idempotency key, deadline, input revision and explicit output/effect scope.
stages.failure: Changed requirements need a new reconciled request; never reuse an older acknowledgment.

stages.action: Existing owner acknowledges exact request hash and continuation session.
stages.failure: Missing acknowledgment is pending, not started or accepted.

stages.action: Existing admission/collector/launcher checks authentic observations and acquires the exclusive lease before effects.
stages.failure: Template validity cannot admit or launch; unavailable inputs route to their existing owner.

stages.action: Execute only bounded work; consumers read qualified local data and route acquisition/persistence/repair/refresh to _FETCH.
stages.failure: Record failed or parked outcome and evidence; never create an independent analyst fetcher.

stages.action: For uncertain writes inspect destination and receipt/readback first; reconcile same idempotency key without reapplying effects.
stages.failure: Unresolved uncertainty blocks retry and completion.

stages.action: Record exact request-bound outcome, source revision, actual execution evidence and remaining gates.
stages.failure: Schedule configuration and session start are not run completion; missing receipt blocks handoff.

stages.action: Separate consumer/independent acceptance from producer completion; resume from the existing checkpoint.
stages.failure: No acceptance or integration without the appropriate owner's evidence.

adoption_matrix.rule: persistent conversation discovery and resume defaults
adoption_matrix.integration: Reconcile Copier/bootstrap defaults in the existing owner branch.
Adopt scoped instructions through the existing policy owner; preserve publication gates.
Register reference pointers and unresolved dependencies without a second queue.

adoption_matrix.rule: host, request identity, ownership and uncertainty
adoption_matrix.integration: Use existing preflight.evaluate; bind authentic collector observations and atomically enforce lease/path/effect checks in the real launcher.
Retain shared component call/result and artifact reference definitions; resolve actual evidence through existing conformance components.
Review exact new revision and real consumer semantics; synthetic shape checks are insufficient.
Resolve current _FETCH owner and qualified root; serve read-only consumers and own acquisition/persistence/repair/refresh. Historical #207 does not grant ownership of a newer maintainer.

adoption_matrix.rule: durable idempotency, recurring runs and checkpoint recovery
adoption_matrix.governing_owner: existing B00 controller and scheduler/runtime owners
adoption_matrix.integration: Enforce duplicate-wake coalescing and actual effect reconciliation through existing protocol/ledger; schedule configuration is not execution evidence.

refinement.reuse_rule: Prior fulfillment never replaces current generation-matched freshness readback for a new demand.
refinement.privacy_rule: A branch in a public repository does not satisfy a private-data destination requirement.
